content: Community best-practice pattern (not an official Clerk-mandated rule): store Clerk's string userId directly as a TEXT column (e.g. clerk_user_id) on app tables rather than mirroring a separate users table via webhook sync, unless the app needs extra per-user data Clerk doesn't hold. Index the column. Single-source WebSearch finding, not independently corroborated by an official doc — treat as ASSUMED-level guidance.
